Definition: dative case of G4771; to thee:--thee, thine own, thou, thy.
BiblicalUsage: This little word is the dative of thou, the thee that something is given to or done for. The Scripture preached the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed, and Paul tells Timothy not to neglect the gift that is in thee, the unfeigned faith that is in thee also.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the smallness of the word is the point: blessing came to the nations in one man, and faith lives in one person at a time.
